name: Finley Solar Farm
current_developer: Finley Solar Farm Pty Ltd as The trustee for Finley Solar Trust
notable: 133 MW solar farm near Finley in the Riverina, NSW. Developed by ESCO Pacific (now John Laing). One of the first large-scale solar farms in the southern Riverina.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Finley Solar Farm Environmental Impact Statement (SSD-8540) - ESCO Pacific
eis_specs.notes: ESCO Pacific (asset sold to John Laing Nov 2018). 133-175 MWac / ~175 MWdc (DC:AC ~1.32). Over 490,000 Canadian Solar high-efficiency modules on single-axis trackers across ~385 ha, 6 km west of Finley. 33 kV underground collection cables into onsite substation to TransGrid Finley 132 kV substation. Consent 29 January 2018. BlueScope PPA for 66% output.
